messages:
Anya: Heads-up — rolled microversion v3.1.2-int4 to 2% via the microversion ledger this morning. Seeing ~12ms latency improvement but a small quality drift on long-doc MRR.
Sam: Can you drop the diffs / sample IDs? want to check slices.
Anya: Pasting quick summary + a couple example prompts:
```
metric_delta: {mrr:-0.9%, accuracy:-0.3%}
latency: {-12ms p50, -8ms p95}
cost_per_token: -18%
sample_count: 8.3k
slice: long-docs (>2k tokens)
```
examples: prompt ids 9812, 9820 (long instructions)
Phillip: 0.9% MRR drop at 2% traffic is borderline. What's our auto-fallback rule now? I thought it was 0.5% between baseline and candidate on critical slices.
Luis: Current config in the rollout ledger: `auto_fallback_thresholds:{global:1.0,critical_slices:0.5}`. Critical slices count as long-doc and QA-sensitive.
Anya: Right — this candidate tripped critical slice >0.5 but global <1.0. Manual flag from QA suggested hold.
QA: We ran 200 deterministic evals — hallucination rate on contract-summary slice jumped 1.8% (small absolute, but concentrated). Samples attached.
Marie: Suggestion: keep canary at 2%, flip that traffic into shadow for 24h and run targeted rerank+long-doc eval set. Also increase sampling of user-facing errors from 10% -> 40% for those routes.
Sam: Agree. Also add per-microversion diff telemetry for KV cache miss rates — I suspect cache alignment changed with quant kernels.
Anya: Noted. Infra can you kick the shadow run and bump sampling?
infra-bot: shadow-run v3.1.2-int4 initiated on route group `long-docs`. sampling=40%. ETA 24h. Will surface shield metrics to /dash/microversions/1759990001.
Phillip: If shadow confirms MRR drop persists we should trigger circuit-breaker and rollback. Proposal: auto-fallback if (critical_slice_delta <= -0.5% AND pvalue < 0.05) OR (absolute hallucination_increase >= 1.0%).
Sam: Add time hysteresis: require condition hold for 3 consecutive 10-min windows to avoid flapping.
Luis: I'll update the ledger rules to reflect that and set an alert to ping #eng-oncall + #product when rule fires.
Marie: Also record a short eval notebook showing debiasing attempts and whether int4 quantization knobs mitigate the hallucination spike.
Anya: I'll hold promotion. For now no further traffic increase until shadow results. Thx all.
